SELECT a.order_code, a.consignee_name, SUM(b.num) AS product_num, a.actual_payment, a.payment_time FROM order_manage a INNER JOIN order_manage_detail b ON a.id = b.order_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY a.order_code, a.consignee_name, a.actual_payment, a.payment_time

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingPayment, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingShipment, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingPickup FROM order_manage WHERE user_id = '1' AND del_flag = '0'
